description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the magic item showcase workflow: create a magic item showcase from an owned reference image. Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_magic_item_showcase with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_magic_item_showcase.

sourceImageId.description: Owned still image UUID from chargen_search_gallery

name: chargen_quote_recipe_magic_item_showcase
title: Quote magic item showcase
